# /crav1-model-data

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [Model the data](../../from-model-data.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-model-data/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Build or revise one data model from the project's specs, with a manual flow or an auto flow.

[`/crav1-model-data`](crav1-model-data.md) (1.118.0) is one skill with `manual-flow` and `auto-flow`. The same rules apply. A scope value is optional. Discovery explains which specs are in and out. Scope is not confirmed until the user says yes. Area and platform views both stay available and neither is the default. Selection comes from the docs. The existing model is judged against the business need first. A genuine tie is the user's choice. Manual flow confirms the business model before physical design. Auto flow, after a shown budget of 20 minutes and 5 shared correction passes, keeps every unconfirmed result a proposal, including conditional physical detail. The saved model is `docs/data-model/<model>/`. `Approved:` names the exact stage and revision. Review comments become proposed revisions. Spec edits, schema, and migration code are offered, not written.

Both flows call `scripts/model_run.py` in this skill. That script is the state machine for discovery gates, worked examples, approval, drift, the auto budget, and the PDF review. It does not score candidates.

1.121.0: `revise` records a new version of a decision, worked example, question, or diagram, keeps the previous text in `history.md`, and sets the item back to proposed (a question stays open). A hand edit is refused until it is redone with `revise`. On Windows run `py -3`, elsewhere `python3`, and try the other if the first is missing. Content goes through `--input` or `--text-file`. The fields are in `references/inputs.md`. The script reads its own clock. The first auto proposal is a baseline and does not use a correction pass. A revise during an open auto run stays inside the current pass.

## Choice words

Exact words for bots and scripted runs (no `--flags`). A word in the invocation takes that choice without asking. A headless or bot run with no word stops and names the valid words.

| Question | Word | Means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Which flow | `manual-flow` | Confirm scope, then the business model, then physical design. An optional scope value may follow the word. |
| Which flow | `auto-flow` | After the budget is approved, run every step. Unconfirmed results stay proposals. An optional scope value may follow the word. |

The scope is an optional value, not the characters [scope]. Neither the area view nor the platform view is the default.

## Runs when

You want a data model from the specs. Called by the user.

## Prompts

Manual-flow: the flow question only when the word is absent, one scope confirmation, one batch of decision-changing questions, business-model confirmation, physical-design confirmation, and one closing yes for the spec link. Auto-flow: one budget approval (20 minutes and 5 shared correction passes, or the numbers the user sets) and no intermediate confirmation. A value the user left out is outside the budget. A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: The scoped specs and system notes, then the saved model on a later run.

Reads the specs and system notes the scope includes, the saved model when one exists, and the sources it pinned. It does not read production data.

## Writes

In short: `docs/data-model/<model>/`, and a `Data model:` line on a spec after a yes.

Writes `docs/data-model/<model>/` through `scripts/model_run.py`: confirmed snapshots, proposed revisions, questions, comparisons, sources, `history.md` when an item is revised (1.121.0), an auto checkpoint when a run stops, and nothing else. After a yes it may add only the line `Data model: docs/data-model/<model>/` on a relevant spec. `report-data-model-full` on [`/crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this`](crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this.md) writes the review snapshot.

## Does not

Leaves spec requirements, schema, migration code, and the confirmed model alone until an explicit approval of that stage and revision. Refuses a hand edit of a model file (1.121.0).

Limits and exceptions: No flow word asks, and a headless run with no word stops. An open auto run cannot approve. A tie is not given a winner. Unknown feasibility is not an exclusion. A hand edit is not a revision.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md); [`/crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this`](crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this.md) report-data-model-full <model>; [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill. It may name [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md), [`/crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this`](crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this.md), and [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md).
